meta.title: The vehicle-refinance competitive universe — hand-verified operator census, title loan AND hire purchase
meta.label: ESTIMATED-from-public-reports — an editorial census of every material operator in the Thai vehicle/land title-loan space, hand-verified 2026-07-20 from company sites, SET filings and press. Footprint figures are the companies' OWN public claims (cited), not our measurement. App scores join live from the measured Play ladder (app_reviews.json) at build time.
meta.market_note: Thai title-loan market size widely reported at ~฿400bn outstanding when KBank entered (2023); the four SET-listed pure-plays alone hold ~฿380bn gross loans (Q1-2026 filings).

meta.tier_note: tier values: 'us' = AutoX; 'nonbank' and 'bank' = operators running a PHYSICAL branch network and therefore countable in per-branch rival density; 'broker' = online origination with no branches, tracked for narrative completeness ONLY and never counted as local competitive pressure. The bank-tier hire-purchase refinancers added in the 2026-08-16 widening run NO branch network of their own and so, like brokers, add nothing to per-branch rival density — they compete on price and channel, not on proximity.
meta.scope_note: WIDENED 2026-08-16 from จำนำทะเบียน-only to EVERY operator that refinances a vehicle, on the owner's instruction ('basically everyone in the space of refinance of vehicles either through hire purchase OR title loan'). `loan_type` carries the distinction and it is not cosmetic: 'hp_refinance' operators take the registration book (โอนเล่ม) and advertise a FLAT rate, 'title_loan' operators leave it with the borrower (ไม่โอนเล่ม) and advertise REDUCING BALANCE. The two conventions are ~4x apart on the poster and about level on the cost of money, so mixing them without conversion is the central trap in reading this market. source-data/rival_rate_card.json holds the published rate cards; pipeline/rate_basis.py does the conversion.
meta.ad_search_note: `ad_search_terms` is the PARENT LEGAL ENTITY each product-branded operator advertises under, used by pull_google_ads.py --discover. Without it a search for 'Car2Cash' or 'My Car My Cash' returns nothing and the operator is filed as having no Google advertiser account — a false measured absence. This is the same trap that hid เงินเทอร์โบ behind 'NGERNTURBO INSURANCE BROKER COMPANY LIMITED' until 2026-08-15. An empty discover result is only ever recorded as NO_ACCOUNT after the parent entity has been searched too.
meta.rate_url_note: MEASURED 2026-08-16 from a Thai residential IP. `rate_url` is the page on which that operator states its own interest rate, confirmed by reading the number off the page. `rate_fetch` is http where a plain fetch suffices and browser where the page is a JS shell or sits behind bot mitigation (KBank and KKP answer a plain fetch 403; a patched headless Chromium with a real user-agent gets 200). Operators with NO rate_url are not yet found and are listed in rate_url_missing rather than being given a guessed URL: GSB_MEETEE, KKP, WSOL_CARFINN, KBANK_RCD.
meta.fb_page_note: MEASURED 2026-08-16. `fb_page` is the operator's Facebook slug, read off a link on their OWN website rather than guessed from the brand name — a guessed slug returns Facebook's 'content isn't available' page instead of failing, which is how the first pass silently got nothing for เงินติดล้อ (real slug ngerntidlor, not tidlor). `fb_page_is_product` is false where the page covers the whole company rather than the vehicle-loan product, so its posts and follower count must NOT be read as that product's share of voice. Without a logged-in session Facebook serves the page identity, follower and 'talking about' counts, and the single newest post truncated at 'ดูเพิ่มเติม' — enough for a daily movement signal, not enough for a promo archive. No page found for: CIMB_AUTO.

operators.name_th: คาร์ฟินน์ (CarFinn)
operators.name_en: CarFinn (WSOL Public Company Limited, formerly SABUY Technology)
operators.model: ONLINE LOAN BROKER — originates vehicle-title enquiries and refers them to lender partners (Krungsri, TISCO). Does NOT lend off its own balance sheet and runs NO branch network.
operators.note: Investigated 2026-08-01 after the owner asked whether a 'เงินสบาย' title lender existed. It does not. SABUY Technology renamed to WSOL Plc; its vehicle-lending exposure is a 20% stake in CarFinn, a broker platform. Carried at tier='broker' so the record is explicit rather than absent — an absent operator invites the same question again, and the wrong answer (treating it as a branch rival) would overstate rival density around our footprint. Brokers are excluded from every per-branch and per-province competitor count by construction: those counts come from the geo censuses (competitor_census.json / competitors_national.json), which only contain physical service points.
